issues.issue: The label says 'assessments'. Irrigation district water assessments are levied on land, so 'special assessments' may fit better than charges for services. Judgment call.
The category rules put water and drainage districts under natural resources/conservation. For an irrigation district that may fit better than 'utilities'. Judgment call (already marked review).
The form doesn't say whether this is principal or interest. Budget-form practice uses debt service principal for combined debt service. Already marked review.
The extractor assumed the fiscal year end. Irrigation districts often use a calendar year (12-31).
